# Repository instructions

## Releases

- When preparing a release or publishing it on request after the changelog PR is merged, use `.github/skills/create-release/SKILL.md`. Merging the PR alone does not authorize or automatically trigger publication.
- When editing `CHANGELOG.md`, follow `.github/instructions/changelog.instructions.md`.
- Release preparation does not authorize pushing tags, publishing releases, or deploying. Obtain explicit approval before these actions.
- Use scoped Conventional Commits for new commit messages and pull request titles: `type(scope): subject`.
